content: On Linux, libsecret over the org.freedesktop.secrets D-Bus Secret Service API (implemented by gnome-keyring and KWallet) is the standard place for a desktop app's API key; keyring files live encrypted in ~/.local/share/keyrings and unlock via PAM at login. Caveat worth documenting: an unlocked session keyring is readable by any process in that session, so it protects against offline/other-account access, not same-session malware. Still strictly better than plaintext config.
